title: tradesQuery request
description: Query trades whose timestamp lies in [startTime, endTime). The range may span at most 86400 seconds (1 day): endTime - startTime <= 86400 and endTime >= startTime. Other requests are answered with success=false and error.code TIME_RANGE_TOO_LARGE or INVALID_TIME_RANGE.

startTime.description: Inclusive range start, Unix epoch seconds.

endTime.description: Exclusive range end, Unix epoch seconds. At most startTime + 86400.
